d_Anear_rule: median mean-nearest-finger-pad-to-target-geom-center distance at causally confirmed bilateral-contact and lifted observations in three fixed same-task train references
robot_point_rule: finger pad collision geom centers, fallback finger collision geom centers, then saved finger sites
object_point_rule: correct target object collision geom centers, fallback saved object sites or object center
distance_rule: mean over selected gripper points of nearest selected target object point Euclidean distance; geom centers are not physical surface distances
initial_rule: A and D use each rollout initial observation as baseline, not per-trajectory extrema
success_rule: restore same-frame MuJoCo sim state; call official task check_success without a physics step; if true P=100 else min(P_raw,99)
contact_rule: record saved contact flags and restored same-frame post-forward flags separately; use restored flags for bilateral grasp and support because saved contact records can differ at transient contact
smoothing: causal contact confirmation only; no whole-curve cumulative maximum, terminal rescale, or future frame use
